cues: When concentrations are not one molar, the Nernst equation corrects the E M F: E cell equals E nought cell, minus zero point zero five nine one over n, times log Q. Pure solids and liquids do not appear in Q.
The zero point zero five nine one is just two point three zero three R T over F, at twenty five degrees.
